source: Live in-page same-origin fetch through Cloudflare Browser Rendering; independent public web search for Google visibility
scope: Primary, legacy, and qualified sitemap indexes; all advertised child sitemaps; 17 representative destination URLs

global_catalog.eligibility: seo_approved=1, description length >=100, name present and HTTPS image; approved supplier records only

limitations: In-page/browser HTTP 200 is not a verified Googlebot request
Authenticated Search Console tool still returns invalid_grant; resubmission and latest last-read status not verified
Indexing decisions for all URLs are Google's, not inferred from sitemap listing
No full HTTP GET or structured data audit was run for every listed destination URL
The duplicate /b/ inclusion is noncritical but should be deduplicated when consolidating blog indexes
No bulk supplier indexing or merchant sync executed
